detailled_description:
Division 01 encompasses all food and non-alcoholic beverages purchased by households for consumption or preparation at home, as well as specific services related to the processing of primary goods for personal use. It covers a comprehensive range of edible products and liquid refreshments intended for nourishment, regardless of whether they require further preparation or are sold as ready-to-consume items.

This includes, among others:

*   **Food Products (011):** A broad array of edible goods, including cereals and bakery products (0111); meat, poultry, and game (0112); fish and other seafood (0113); milk, dairy products, and eggs (0114); oils, fats, and spreads (0115); fruits, nuts, and vegetables (0116, 0117); as well as confectionery, sweeteners, ready-made meals, baby food, and various culinary seasonings and flavorings (0118, 0119).
*   **Non-alcoholic Beverages (012):** All non-alcoholic liquids for refreshment, such as fruit and vegetable juices (0121); coffee, tea, and other infusions (0122, 0123); cocoa and chocolate-based drinks (0124); water (0125); soft drinks (0126); and other specialty non-alcoholic beverages (0129).
*   **Processing Services (013):** Services purchased by households for the transformation of raw materials into food or non-alcoholic beverages for their own consumption, such as cereal grinding, oil pressing, custom slaughtering, and juice extraction (0130).

This does not include food and non-alcoholic beverages provided by food and beverage serving services, such as restaurants, cafés, and canteens (Division 11). Furthermore, this division excludes products intended for animal feeding (09.3.2.2), services related to the local delivery of food when separately priced (07.4.9.2), alcoholic beverages (02.1), and services involving the crushing or pressing of products specifically for the production of alcoholic beverages (02.2).

Group 01.1 encompasses all food products purchased by households for consumption, preparation, or nourishment at home, spanning from raw agricultural commodities to highly processed ready-to-eat meals. This category includes all edible goods intended for human consumption, regardless of whether they require further cooking or are sold as ready-made preparations.

This includes, among others:

*   **Cereals and Bakery Goods:** Grain-based products including dried grains (wheat, rice, maize), flours, breakfast cereals, pasta, noodles, and various bakery items such as bread, cakes, and biscuits (0111).
*   **Animal-based Protein:** Live land animals intended for consumption, as well as meat, offal, and animal parts of livestock, poultry, and game (0112); and all varieties of fish, crustaceans, molluscs, and other edible aquatic invertebrates (0113).
*   **Dairy, Eggs, and Alternatives:** Milk and cream (animal and plant-based), cheese, yoghurts, fermented dairy products, eggs, and processed milk-based desserts or beverages (0114).
*   **Oils, Fats, and Spreads:** Edible vegetable oils, butter and milk-derived fats, margarine, lard, and other animal-based cooking fats (0115).
*   **Fruits, Nuts, and Vegetables:** Fresh, frozen, dried, or processed fruits and nuts (0116); and fresh, frozen, or dried vegetables, tubers (potatoes, cassava), plantains, cooking bananas, and pulses (0117).
*   **Confectionery and Sweeteners:** Refined sugars and sweeteners, honey, fruit and nut-based spreads (jams, nut butters), chocolate, cocoa products, and frozen desserts like ice cream and sorbets (0118).
*   **Ready-made Meals and Seasonings:** Convenience foods including prepared meals, pizzas, soups, and sandwiches (01191); specialized infant nutrition and baby food (01192); culinary flavorings such as salt, vinegar, condiments, sauces, and spices; culinary herbs and seeds (01193, 01194); and miscellaneous food preparations like broths and baking agents (01199).

This does not include services related to the local delivery of food or drinks when separately priced (07.4.9.2), products intended for animal feeding (09.3.2.2), or food provided by food-serving services such as restaurants, cafés, and canteens (Division 11).

details.includes: * products that need to be cooked or further prepared as well as ready-made food
details.excludes: * services related to local delivery of food or drinks, when separately priced (07.4.9.2) * products for animal feeding (09.3.2.2) * food provided by food serving services (division 11)

detailled_description:
This category encompasses a broad range of grain-based food products, covering primary agricultural cereal crops, their milled derivatives, and various processed bakery and pantry goods. It serves as a comprehensive classification for commodities derived from cereal grains intended for human consumption, spanning from raw or dried grains to complex prepared items such as bread, pasta, and breakfast cereals.

This includes, among others:
* **Cereals and Grains:** Dried cereal grains and pseudocereals, including wheat, rice, sorghum, barley, millet, maize, quinoa, teff, buckwheat, and mixed cereal grains (01111).
* **Flours:** Milled powders derived from cereals, including instant, pre-steamed, and bakery flour mixtures with added yeasts (01112).
* **Bakery Products:** Bread, bread rolls, crispbreads, rusks, and various sweet or savory bakery items such as biscuits, cookies, waffles, muffins, croissants, cakes, and plain pizza bases (01113).
* **Breakfast Cereals:** Grain-based breakfast products, including cornflakes, oatmeal, muesli, granola, and puffed cereals (01114).
* **Pasta and Similar Products:** Uncooked pasta, noodles, couscous, dumplings, and ravioli (01115).
* **Other Milled Products:** Processed cereal-based items such as baking mixes, doughs, popcorn, granola bars, malt extracts, cereal-based chips, and cereal-derived meat substitutes like seitan (01119).

This does not include cereal-based ready-made preparations like prepared soups (01.1.9.1), baby rice cereals and other specialized infant cereal preparations (01.1.9.2), seeds intended for planting (09.3.1.2), non-cereal flours (e.g., nut or fruit flours) (01.1.6.9.1), pizza with toppings (01.1.9.1), meat substitutes derived from legumes, vegetables, or nuts (e.g., soy meat, tofu, tempeh) (01.1.7.9), or starches such as potato starch, tapioca, and sago (01.1.7.9).

This category encompasses dried cereal grains intended for consumption, including those that are broken or precooked (steamed), provided they have not undergone further processing or manufacturing. It covers a wide range of botanical cereal species and grains prepared for culinary use in their whole or broken state.

This includes, among others:
* **Wheat and wheat-based grains:** Including bulgur, farro (broken and pearled), and wheat (011111).
* **Rice:** Including husked, semi-milled, wholly milled, and parboiled rice (011112).
* **Major global cereals:** Comprising sorghum (011113), barley (011114), millet (011115), and maize (corn), whether on the cob or as loose grains (011116).
* **Pseudocereals and specialized grains:** Such as quinoa (011117), teff (011118), buckwheat, quihuicha (Inca wheat), and canagua (011119).
* **Other cereals and mixtures:** Including rye, oats, triticale, canary seed, and adlay (Job’s tears). This category also encompasses mixed cereal grains in dried form, which may contain other dehydrated ingredients (such as vegetables), provided that the cereal remains the primary component (011119).

This does not include: flour of cereals (01.1.1.2), breakfast cereals (01.1.1.4), cereal-based ready-made preparations like soups (01.1.9.1), baby rice cereals and other specialized infant cereal preparations (01.1.9.2), or seeds intended for planting (09.3.1.2).

detailled_description:
This category encompasses flours derived from various cereals, covering all types of processing including instant, pre-steamed, or products fortified with yeasts. It serves to classify primary cereal-based powders used for culinary and bakery preparations.

This category includes flours obtained from specific grains, such as wheat (01.1.1.2.1), rice (01.1.1.2.2), sorghum (01.1.1.2.3), barley (01.1.1.2.4), millet (01.1.1.2.5), maize or cornmeal (01.1.1.2.6), quinoa (01.1.1.2.7), teff (01.1.1.2.8), and other cereals not elsewhere classified (01.1.1.2.9). These products may be in their standard form or processed as instant flour, including pre-steamed varieties like polenta flour (01.1.1.2.6) and bakery flour mixtures containing added yeasts.

This category does not include flour products specifically formulated as baby food, baby rice cereals, or other specialized baby cereals (01.1.9.2.2). Additionally, it excludes non-cereal flours, such as those derived from nuts (e.g., almond flour) or fruits (01.1.6.9.1).

details.includes: * flour of cereals listed under subclass 1.1.1.1
details.alsoIncludes: * instant flour for bakery products with yeasts added * polenta flour, whether instant (pre-steamed) or not
details.excludes: * flour as baby food, baby rice cereals and other baby cereals (01.1.9.2)

detailled_description:
This category encompasses a wide range of grain-based food products, specifically focusing on bread and diverse sweet or savory bakery goods. It covers essential staple items as well as confectionery-style pastry products prepared by baking.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Bread and staple bakery products:** Fresh bread and bread rolls, as well as long-life alternatives such as crispbreads, rusks, toasted bread, crackers, tortillas, and injera (011131).
*   **Pastry and sweet bakery goods:** Various baked items such as gingerbread, sweet biscuits (cookies), waffles, wafers, and ice cream cones. It also includes breakfast and dessert goods like crumpets, muffins, croissants, sweet tarts, sweet pies, and other pastry goods or cakes, as well as plain pizza bases without toppings, whether precooked or not (011139).

This does not include pizza with toppings (whether precooked or not), quiche, or meat and fish pies (01.1.9.1).

detailled_description: This category encompasses a variety of grain-based food products specifically intended for consumption as breakfast cereals. It includes various forms of processed cereals, such as cornflakes, oatmeal and oat flakes, muesli, granola, and puffed cereals, including puffed rice cakes. Furthermore, this category covers breakfast cereals that are enhanced with additional ingredients such as nuts or dried fruit. This does not include popcorn (1.1.1.9).

description: Macaroni, noodles, couscous and similar pasta products (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses various forms of pasta, noodles, and cereal-based products that are typically sold in an uncooked state. It serves as a comprehensive classification for dry, shelf-stable pasta preparations intended for subsequent cooking by the consumer.

This category includes, among others, all varieties of uncooked pasta, whether stuffed or unstuffed, such as macaroni and noodles (011150). It also encompasses uncooked dumplings, ravioli, and similar filled pasta products, as well as couscous in its dry, uncooked form (011150).

This category does not include bulgur (01.1.1.1) or prepared dishes that contain stuffed pasta and pre-cooked or prepared couscous dishes (01.1.9.1).

details.includes: * uncooked pasta, whether stuffed or not, and couscous * uncooked dumplings, ravioli and similar products

description: Other milled cereal and grain products (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses a wide variety of milled cereal and grain products that have undergone further processing beyond basic milling. It includes specialized food items derived from grains, such as snacks, baking components, and plant-based protein alternatives.

This category includes, among others, dry mixes and doughs designed for the preparation of bakery products, as well as prepared snack items like popcorn and cereal-based chips and crisps. It also covers granola bars, malt and malt extracts, and seitan or other meat substitutes specifically formulated from cereals.

This does not include ready-made cereal-based preparations, such as ready-made soups (01.1.9.1), or meat substitutes derived from vegetables, legumes, or nuts (such as soy meat, tofu, tempeh, or veggie burgers) and starches like potato starch, tapioca, and sago (01.1.7.9).

description: Live animals, and meat and other parts of slaughtered land animals (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses live land animals intended for human consumption, as well as the meat, offal, and blood of slaughtered land and marine animals in various forms of preservation. It covers the full spectrum of animal-based food products, ranging from live livestock and fresh, chilled, or frozen cuts to processed, dried, and prepared meat items.

This includes, among others:
* **Live Animals:** Live land animals, including bovine animals, pigs, goats, sheep, lambs, poultry (chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys), small game (hares, rabbits), and various other land animals such as equines, camelids, birds, reptiles, and edible insects (01121).
* **Fresh and Frozen Meat:** Meat of livestock, poultry, game, and marine mammals (seals, whales, etc.) presented fresh, chilled, or frozen, including whole cuts and minced meat (01122).
* **Preserved Meat:** Meat that has been dried, salted, brined, or smoked, such as bacon, ham, and salami (01123).
* **Offal and Animal Parts:** Edible bones, blood, and specific animal parts such as pork heads, tails, ears, and chicken feet, regardless of their preservation state (01124).
* **Meat Preparations:** Processed, ready-to-cook, or preserved meat products including sausages, canned meat, meat extracts, meat juices, breaded meats, and various types of pâtés (01125).

This does not include live fish (01.1.3.1), other live seafood (01.1.3.4), live animals intended for transport (07.1.4.0), or live animals purchased for recreational purposes (09.1.2.4).

This category encompasses live land animals, including both domestic and wild species, that are purchased specifically for human consumption as food.

This includes, among others:
*   **Bovine animals:** Cattle (cows, calves, common ox, zebu or humped ox, watusi, gaur, gayal, banteng, and yak) and buffaloes (Indian, water, arnis, Asiatic, Celebes anoas, African dwarf and Caffrarian, American bisons, European bisons, and beefaloes) (011211).
*   **Livestock:** Pigs (011212), as well as goats, lambs, and sheep (011213).
*   **Poultry and small game:** Chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys, guinea fowl (011214), as well as hares and rabbits (011215).
*   **Other land animals:** Horses, donkeys, and other equines; camels, dromedaries, and camelids (alpaca, llamas, guanacos, vicuñas); various birds (ostriches, emus, rheas, pheasants, grouse, pigeons, quails); reptiles (snakes); insects, spiders, scorpions, and worms; terrestrial snails; and frogs (011219).

This category does not include live fish (01.1.3.1), other live seafood (01.1.3.4), live animals intended for transport (07.1.4.0), or live animals purchased for recreational purposes (09.1.2.4).

detailled_description:
This category encompasses the meat of a wide range of domestic and wild animals, provided in fresh, chilled, or frozen form. It covers meat derived from livestock, poultry, game, and other animal sources, including minced meat and meat from marine mammals.

This category includes, among others:
* **Bovine meat:** Meat of cattle (cows, calves, oxen, zebu, watusi, gaur, gayal, banteng, and yak) and buffaloes (Indian or water buffaloes, arnis, Asiatic, Sulawesi anoas, African buffaloes, American and European bisons, and beefaloes) (011221).
* **Porcine, Ovine, and Caprine meat:** Meat of pigs (011222), as well as meat of goats, lambs, and sheep (011223).
* **Poultry and Small Game:** Meat of poultry, such as chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys, and guinea fowl (011224), and meat of hares and rabbits (011225).
* **Equine and Camelid meat:** Meat of horses, donkeys, and other equines (011226), and meat of camels, dromedaries, alpacas, llamas, guanacos, vicuñas, and other camelids (011227).
* **Other miscellaneous meat:** This includes meat of wild animals and exotic species, such as antelopes, deer, boars, and kangaroos; meat of birds (ostriches, emus, rheas, pheasants, grouse, pigeons, and quails); reptiles (snakes, alligators); amphibians (frogs); terrestrial snails; and non-live insects, spiders, scorpions, and worms. It also explicitly includes the meat of marine mammals, such as seals, walruses, and whales (011229). 

All listed types of meat are included whether they are presented as whole cuts or as minced meat.

This category does not include live animals or processed meat products that have been cured, smoked, or otherwise preserved beyond simple chilling or freezing.

description: Meat, dried, salted, in brine or smoked (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses various types of meat obtained from domestic and wild animals that have been preserved through drying, salting, brining, or smoking. It covers a broad spectrum of animal products intended for human consumption, ranging from common livestock to exotic meats and insects.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Bovine Meat:** Salted, dried, or smoked meat derived from cattle (including cows, calves, ox, zebu, watusi, and yaks) and various species of buffaloes and bisons (011231).
*   **Pork Products:** Processed pork cuts, including specifically identified items such as bacon, ham, and salami (011232).
*   **Other Preserved Meats:** Meat from wild game (antelopes, deer, boars, kangaroos), marine mammals (seals, walruses, whales), birds (ostriches, emus, pheasants, pigeons, quails), reptiles (snakes, alligators), as well as terrestrial snails, frogs, and edible insects such as spiders, scorpions, and worms (011239).

This category does not include meat-based pâtés or similar spreads (01.1.2.5).

details.includes: * meat of all animals listed in 01.1.2.2, both domestic and wild, dried, salted, in brine or smoked * bacon, ham and salami

description: Offal, blood and other parts of slaughtered animals, fresh, chilled or frozen, dried, salted, in brine or smoked (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses edible parts of slaughtered animals that are not classified as primary meat cuts, preserved through various methods such as fresh, chilled, frozen, dried, salted, in brine, or smoked. It covers a diverse range of animal by-products intended for human consumption or further processing.

This includes, among others, edible animal bones (01124), as well as specific animal extremities and offal such as pork heads, tails, and ears, and chicken feet (01124). 

This does not include preparations of offal, blood, and other parts of slaughtered animals (01125).

details.includes: * bones * pork heads, tails and ears; and chicken feet
details.excludes: * preparations of offal, blood and other parts of slaughtered animals (01.1.2.5)

description: Preparations of meat, offal, blood and other parts of slaughtered animals (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses a comprehensive range of meat-based products, including preparations of meat, offal, and blood, whether processed, preserved, or presented in fresh, frozen, or ready-to-cook forms. It covers both shelf-stable preserved goods and convenience-oriented culinary meat preparations.

This category includes, among others:
* **Sausage products:** Sausages and similar products derived from meat, offal, or blood (011251).
* **Canned and preserved products:** Meat of all animal types that has been precooked and preserved in cans (011252).
* **Pâtés:** All varieties of pâté, including liver pâté (011253).
* **Other processed meat preparations:** Various culinary preparations such as marinated meats, meat extracts, meat juices, mixed minced meat, breaded meat products, and other preparations of meat, offal, or blood not elsewhere classified (011259).

details.includes: * sausages and similar meat, offal and blood products * marinated meat * canned meat, meat extracts and meat juices * minced meat mix, from different types of meat * all kind of pâté, including liver pâté * breaded meat * other preparations of meat, offal and blood

detailled_description:
This category encompasses all fish and other seafood, including crustaceans, molluscs, and various aquatic invertebrates, intended for human consumption. It covers these products in all states—live, fresh, chilled, or frozen—as well as those preserved by drying, salting, brining, smoking, or other culinary preparations.

This includes, among others:
*   **Fish:** All species of fish (including freshwater species, salmonoids, flatfish, gadiformes, and pelagic fish), provided as whole, fillets, or minced meat (01131, 01132, 01133). This also covers fish preparations such as canned fish, surimi, breaded fillets, and imitation crabmeat, as well as caviar and caviar substitutes (01133).
*   **Other Seafood:** A broad range of aquatic invertebrates, including crustaceans (shrimps, prawns, crabs, lobsters, crayfish, krill, and sea spiders), molluscs (bivalves such as oysters, scallops, mussels, and clams; cephalopods such as squid, cuttlefish, and octopus; and other molluscs like abalone and sea snails), and other aquatic organisms (sea urchins, sea cucumbers, sea squirts, and jellyfish) (01134, 01135, 01136).
*   **Offal and By-products:** All secondary edible parts of fish and seafood, including livers, roes, fins, maws, and other anatomical offal, regardless of whether they are fresh, frozen, preserved, or processed into meal (01137).

This does not include marine mammals, frogs, or terrestrial molluscs such as land snails (01.1.2.1, 01.1.2.2, 01.1.2.3), nor does it include seaweeds and other aquatic plants (01.1.7.4).

details.includes: * aquatic turtles * other edible aquatic invertebrates and animals, such as sea cucumbers, sea urchins, sea squirts and jellyfish
details.excludes: * marine mammals, frogs and terrestrial snails (01.1.2.1, 01.1.2.2, 01.1.2.3) * seaweeds and other aquatic plants (01.1.7.4)

description: Fish, live, fresh, chilled or frozen (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses all types of fish intended for human consumption, provided in a live, fresh, chilled, or frozen state. It includes whole fish, fish fillets, and fish meat, whether minced or not.

This category includes, among others:
*   **Freshwater species:** Including tilapia, catfish (including pangasius), carp, Nile perch, and eels (01.1.3.1.1).
*   **Salmonoidae:** Specifically salmon and trout (01.1.3.1.2).
*   **Flatfish:** Such as sole, turbot, halibut, and plaice (01.1.3.1.3).
*   **Gadiformes:** Including cod, haddock, hake, Alaska pollock, and blue whiting (01.1.3.1.4).
*   **Tuna and related species:** Including tunas and skipjack or stripe-bellied bonito (01.1.3.1.5).
*   **Other pelagic fish:** Including herring, sardines, sardinella, brisling or sprat, mackerel, and swordfish (01.1.3.1.6).
*   **Other fish:** Various other fish species not elsewhere classified (01.1.3.1.9).

This does not include fish meal, livers, roes, fins, maws, or other fish offal (01.1.3.7).

details.includes: * fish, live, purchased as food * fish, fresh, chilled or frozen * fish fillets and meat, whether minced or not, fresh, chilled or frozen
details.excludes: * meal, livers, roes, fins, maws and other offal (01.1.3.7)

description: Fish, dried, salted, in brine or smoked (ND)
detailled_description:
This category encompasses fish that have been preserved through drying, salting, brining, or smoking processes, including whole fish and fish fillets.

The scope of this category includes a variety of preserved fish products classified by species: 
*   **Salmonidae:** Specifically covers smoked salmon and trout (011321). 
*   **Gadiformes:** Includes cod, haddock, hake, Alaska pollock, and blue whiting that are prepared by drying, salting, or brining (011322). 
*   **Other preserved fish:** Encompasses all other fish, including fish fillets and meat, preserved via drying, salting, brining, or smoking that are not elsewhere classified (011329).

This category does not include fish meal, livers, roes, fins, maws, or other fish offal (01.1.3.7).

details.includes: * fish fillets and meat, dried, salted, in brine or smoked
details.excludes: * meal, livers, roes, fins, maws and other offal (01.1.3.7)

detailled_description:
This category encompasses a wide range of prepared and preserved fish products, including those that are frozen or processed for shelf stability. It covers various species of fish, specialized culinary preparations, and roe-based products intended for human consumption.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Tuna and Pelagic Species:** Preparations of tunas, skipjack, or stripe-bellied bonito (011331), as well as other pelagic fish such as herring, sardines, sardinella, brisling, sprat, mackerel, and swordfish (011332).
*   **Roe Products:** Caviar, prepared from the roe of the sturgeon, and caviar substitutes, consisting of the processed and salted eggs of other fish species such as salmon, carp, pike, tuna, mullet, cod, and lumpfish (011333).
*   **General Fish Preparations:** A variety of fish-based foodstuffs including fillets covered in batter or breadcrumbs, canned fish, surimi, and other imitation crabmeat, as well as other fish preparations not elsewhere classified (011339).

This category does not include prepared or preserved livers, roes, fins, and other fish offal (01.1.3.7).

* **Fresh or Chilled Vegetables:** This encompasses leafy and stem vegetables (01171), such as asparagus, cabbages, cauliflowers, broccoli, lettuce, chicory, and spinach; fruit-bearing vegetables (01172), including tomatoes, chillies, peppers, cucumbers, and pumpkins; green leguminous vegetables (01173), such as beans, peas, broad beans, and soya beans; and other fresh or chilled varieties (01174), including root/bulb vegetables (carrots, onions, garlic), mushrooms, truffles, and edible seaweeds.
* **Tubers, Plantains, and Cooking Bananas:** This includes fresh or chilled starchy staples (01175) such as potatoes, sweet potatoes, cassava (manioc/yuca), yams, taro, and plantains.
* **Pulses:** This covers dried leguminous vegetables (01176) such as common beans, chickpeas, lentils, cowpeas, and pigeon peas.
* **Preserved and Processed Varieties:** This includes dried or dehydrated vegetables and tubers (01177); frozen vegetables, tubers, and cooking bananas (01178); and ground preparations (01179). The latter includes flours and starches (potato starch, tapioca, sago), canned vegetables, preserved olives, vegetable chips, pickles, and processed meat substitutes made from vegetables or soy (e.g., tofu, tempeh, veggie burgers).

This does not include dessert bananas (01.1.6.1), seitan or other meat substitutes made primarily from cereals (01.1.1.9), ready-made vegetable preparations containing meat, cheese, or fish (01.1.9.1), ready-made soups (01.1.9.1), homogenized baby food preparations (01.1.9.2), culinary herbs and spices (01.1.9.4), vegetable-based broths and stocks (01.1.9.9), or vegetable juices (01.2.1.0).

The scope of this category is structured into the following clusters:

*   **Ready-Made Meals and Dishes:** This includes precooked meals and convenience foods, such as dishes based on cereals (pasta, rice, couscous), protein (meat, fish, meat substitutes), vegetables, pulses, or potatoes (01191). It also covers precooked egg-based main dishes such as omelettes and crepes (011915).

This category does not include bread and bakery products or cakes (01.1.1.3); uncooked pasta products such as macaroni, noodles, or couscous (01.1.1.5); cheese (01.1.4.5) or yoghurt (01.1.4.6); frozen chipped potatoes (01.1.7.9); ice cream (01.1.8.6) or other desserts (01.1.8.9); and broths and stocks (01.1.9.9.0).

Division 03 encompasses all clothing materials, garments, and accessories, as well as footwear for men, women, and children. This division includes, among others:

This division does not include furnishing fabrics, household textile repairs, or household laundry services; medical hosiery or therapeutic footwear; personal adornments such as jewelry or watches; diapers; umbrellas or other miscellaneous personal articles; and sewing or gardening tools. description: Housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels
detailled_description:
Division 04 encompasses all goods and services related to the occupancy, maintenance, and utility provision of a dwelling. This division covers both monetary and non-monetary household expenditures, including actual and imputed rentals, essential utility supplies, and the costs associated with the routine upkeep and physical security of residential properties.

This division includes the following logical clusters:

*   **Rental Payments:** Expenditures for the use of dwellings, encompassing actual rentals paid by tenants or subtenants for primary or secondary residences (041), and imputed rentals for owner-occupiers, which account for the economic value of the dwelling structure, land, and fixtures (042).
*   **Maintenance, Repair, and Security:** Costs for minor maintenance and repairs of the dwelling, including both materials purchased by tenants or owner-occupiers (such as paints, hardware, and flooring) and services provided by professional tradespeople (e.g., plumbers, electricians, locksmiths), as well as home security devices and surveillance services (043).
*   **Water and Miscellaneous Dwelling Services:** Fees for the supply of water, management of refuse, sewage collection, and various operational services for multi-occupied buildings, including caretaking, common-area maintenance, and environmental testing (044).
*   **Energy Supply:** Expenditures for energy sources required for lighting, heating, cooling, and cooking, including electricity, piped or liquefied gas, liquid and solid fuels (such as heating oil, coal, and firewood), and district heating or cooling services (045).

This does not include major maintenance, structural extensions, or conversions of the dwelling (which are considered capital formation). Furthermore, it excludes non-dwelling-related services such as cleaning products (05.6.1), general household domestic services (05.6.2), fuels for personal transport (07.2.2), costs for accommodation in social or educational institutions (e.g., boarding schools, student housing, retirement homes) (11.2, 13.3), or professional services like bodyguards (13.9).

description: Actual rental payments made for housing
detailled_description:
This category encompasses all actual rental payments made by households for the use of dwellings and associated ancillary spaces. It covers expenditures for both primary residences and secondary properties, as well as payments for related facilities such as garages.

This includes, among others:
*   **Main Residence Rentals:** Payments by tenants or subtenants for furnished or unfurnished premises occupied as a primary place of living, including rooms in hotels or boarding houses used as a main residence (0411).

description: Maintenance, repair and security of the dwelling
detailled_description:
This category encompasses expenditures on materials, equipment, and professional services required for the routine maintenance, minor repairs, and physical security of an individual dwelling. These activities are essential for preserving the dwelling’s functionality and safety without altering its capacity, performance, or expected service life.

This includes, among others:

*   **Maintenance and Repair Materials and Equipment:** Physical components and supplies purchased by households for minor upkeep, including paints, varnishes, renderings, wallpapers, fabric wall coverings, windowpanes, plaster, cement, putty, and wallpaper pastes (0431). It also covers surfacing materials such as floorboards, ceramic tiles, fitted carpets, and linoleum, as well as plumbing components (pipes, taps, joints), hardware (door fittings, power sockets, wiring flex), and application tools like brushes and scrapers (0431).
*   **Security and Surveillance Equipment:** Specialized hardware and safety devices for residential use, including smoke detectors, security alarms, surveillance cameras, door phones (intercoms), and home fire extinguishers (0431).
*   **Maintenance and Repair Services:** Professional labor engaged by households for routine tasks, including services provided by plumbers, electricians, carpenters, glaziers, painters, and decorators, as well as specialized services such as floor polishing and the installation of fitted carpets and linoleum (0432).
*   **Security Services:** Professional locksmith services for the dwelling and general residential security services (0432).

This does not include hand tools (05.5.2.1), lamp bulbs (05.5.2.2), or routine cleaning products such as brooms, scrubbing brushes, and dusting brushes (05.6.1.1). Furthermore, this category excludes fire extinguishers designed for transport equipment (07.2.1.3), locksmith services for motor vehicles (07.2.3.0), and the employment of bodyguards (13.9.0.9). Finally, it excludes any materials or services related to major maintenance, repair, structural extensions, or conversions of the dwelling, which are classified as intermediate consumption or gross fixed capital formation rather than final household consumption.

description: Water supply and miscellaneous services relating to the dwelling
detailled_description:
This category encompasses the provision of essential utility services and miscellaneous operational maintenance tasks required for the functioning and upkeep of a dwelling. It covers the supply of water, the management of household waste and sewage, and various ancillary services related to the environment and shared infrastructure of residential properties.

This includes, among others:
*   **Water Supply:** Fees for water delivered through mains, including volumetric consumption, fixed standing charges, and meter-related expenses, as well as payments for water supplied via public standposts, fountains, or alternative delivery methods like tankers or carts (0441).
*   **Waste Management:** Services related to the regular collection and disposal of household refuse, including fees specifically associated with recycling programs (0442).
*   **Sewage and Sanitation:** Costs for the collection, transport, and disposal of sewage via public sewer systems, as well as services for the emptying and maintenance of on-site sanitation systems like septic tanks and cesspools, and the use of communal or public toilet facilities (0443).
*   **Dwelling-related Services:** Operational and management charges for multi-occupied buildings (e.g., caretaking, lighting and heating of common areas, elevator and refuse chute maintenance), along with specific maintenance tasks such as chimney sweeping, snow removal, road and sidewalk cleaning, grounds landscaping, and internal safety measurements like radiation or pollutant testing (0444).

This does not include drinking water sold in bottles or containers (01.2.5.0), hot water and steam purchased from district heating plants (04.5.5.0), or household maintenance services such as window cleaning, disinfection, fumigation, and pest extermination (05.6.2.9).

This category encompasses the provision of water services to households, whether delivered through conventional network systems or via alternative supply methods. It covers all associated costs and service charges required to facilitate the supply and consumption of water for residential use.

This includes, among others, charges for water delivered through mains, such as volumetric consumption fees, fixed standing charges, and expenses related to meter installation, rentals, and readings (04411). It also includes payments for water services provided at public standposts, fountains, or by water vendors operating via tankers, trucks, or carts (04412).

This category does not include drinking water sold in bottles or containers (01.2.5.0), nor does it include hot water and steam purchased from district heating plants (04.5.5.0).

description: Furnishings, household equipment and routine household maintenance
detailled_description:
Division 05 encompasses the wide range of products, equipment, and services required to furnish, equip, and maintain a household dwelling. It covers the full lifecycle of these goods—including acquisition, routine maintenance, installation, repair, and rental—as well as domestic services performed by paid staff or external enterprises.

This division includes, among others:

*   **Furniture, Lighting, and Furnishings:** Movable household items such as indoor and outdoor furniture (e.g., sofas, tables, beds, storage units), lighting equipment, decorative objects, clocks, mirrors, and loose carpets or rugs (05.1).
*   **Household Textiles:** Finished textile goods for domestic use, including bedding and bed linen, furnishing fabrics, curtains, table and bathroom linens, and miscellaneous household textile accessories (05.2).
*   **Household Appliances:** Both major and small electrical and non-electrical appliances for food and beverage preparation, laundry, climate control, and cleaning (05.3).
*   **Glassware, Tableware, and Utensils:** Durable and semi-durable items used for dining, food preparation, and storage, including cutlery, silverware, ceramic ware, and various kitchen or household hardware (05.4).
*   **Tools and Equipment:** Motorized and manual tools for DIY home improvement and gardening, along with hardware, fittings, and small electrical accessories (05.5).
*   **Routine Maintenance Goods and Services:** Consumable cleaning and maintenance supplies (detergents, disinfectants, and hardware consumables) (05.6.1), as well as domestic services such as cleaning, pest extermination, and the employment of household staff (05.6.2).

This does not include goods or services classified as capital formation (such as structural building fixtures or major antique investments), nor does it include: ornamental garden materials (09.3.1.1); the laying or repair of fitted carpets and linoleum (04.3.2.0); bedding and bed linen (05.2.1.2); personal hygiene items such as toilet paper or soap (13.1.2.0); maintenance products for transport equipment (07.2.1.3); dry-cleaning and laundering of garments (03.1.4.1); utility services like refuse or sewage collection (04.4.2.0, 04.4.3); security services (04.3.2.0); or professional services such as snow removal and chimney sweeping (04.4.4.9).

This category encompasses the acquisition of movable household, garden, and decorative items used to furnish and illuminate living spaces, as well as the professional services related to their maintenance, installation, and temporary provision. It covers the full lifecycle of domestic furniture, lighting fixtures, and furnishings, ranging from initial purchase to restoration and rental.

This includes, among others:
*   **Household, Garden, and Camping Furniture:** Domestic furniture for living areas, bedrooms, and kitchens (e.g., sofas, tables, beds, wardrobes, baby furniture, and custom-made pieces), as well as furniture designed for outdoor use, including benches, tables, arbours, small storage sheds, and camping-specific furniture (0511).
*   **Lighting and Decorative Furnishings:** Indoor and outdoor lighting equipment (e.g., ceiling lights, standard lamps, and LED strings), alongside loose carpets, rugs, wall and floor clocks, mirrors, folding partitions, and non-textile blinds. It also includes ornamental objects such as sculptures, engravings, tapestries, and candle holders (0511).
*   **Maintenance, Installation, and Hire Services:** Professional services for the repair and restoration of furniture, furnishings, and loose carpets, the rental of these items for temporary use, and the installation of furniture when such services are separately priced (0512).

This does not include decorative garden materials (09.3.1.1); the laying or repair of fitted carpets and linoleum (04.3.2.0); bedding and bed linen (05.2.1.2); sunshades (05.2.1.9); safes (05.3.1.9); ornamental glass and ceramic articles (05.4.0.1); light bulbs, tubes, and individual LEDs (05.5.2.2); dry-cleaning or professional shampooing of carpets (05.6.2.9); delivery or installation services (if bundled) (07.4.9.2); light strings for Christmas trees (09.2.1.3); camping equipment (09.2.2.2); carrycots, pushchairs, or wall thermometers (13.2.9.1); or works of art and antique furniture acquired primarily as financial stores of value (capital formation).

It covers the acquisition of movable domestic furniture, lighting fixtures, and various aesthetic or functional furnishings used to equip a home.

This includes, among others:

This category encompasses a comprehensive range of electrical and non-electrical appliances used for domestic maintenance, as well as the associated services required for their upkeep, installation, and temporary use. It covers the life cycle of household machinery, from the acquisition of major and small appliances to professional maintenance and rental services.

This category includes the following functional clusters:

*   **Major Household Appliances:** This includes large-scale motorized or fuel-powered equipment for domestic tasks. This comprises major kitchen appliances such as refrigerators, freezers, dishwashers, and various cooking panels, hobs, and ovens (0531); laundry appliances including washing machines, dryers, and ironing machines (0531); climate control equipment such as air conditioners, heaters, and ventilators (0531); and cleaning equipment like vacuum cleaners and floor polishers (0531). It also covers other specialized major items such as sewing machines, knitting machines, and water softeners (0531).
*   **Small Household Appliances:** This includes smaller devices designed for food and beverage preparation, as well as general home maintenance. This comprises food preparation machines (mixers, blenders, toasters, deep fryers, and grills) (0532); beverage preparation devices (coffee makers, kettles, and juice extractors) (0532); and other small appliances such as electric irons, fans, and electric blankets (0532). Both electric and non-electric versions are included where applicable.
*   **Repair, Installation, and Hire:** This includes professional services associated with household appliances, specifically the expert repair of equipment, the installation of appliances when priced as a separate service, and the short-term hire or rental of household machinery (0533).

This does not include appliances that are built into the structure of the building (which are treated as capital formation), small non-electric household articles and kitchen utensils (05.4.0.3), baby scales (06.1.2.1), or personal weighing machines (13.1.2.0). Additionally, it excludes parts or materials purchased by households for self-maintenance, which are classified within the respective appliance categories rather than the service category.

Division 06 encompasses a comprehensive range of health-related products and services intended to prevent, diagnose, and treat illnesses, diseases, and injuries, as well as to maintain or restore health and physical well-being. It includes the provision of medical goods for personal use, specialized clinical care provided with or without an overnight stay, and essential diagnostic and emergency transport services.

This division includes, among others:

*   **Medicines and Health Products:** All pharmaceutical preparations, vaccines, medical devices, and assistive products (e.g., eyeglasses, hearing aids, wheelchairs) purchased for use outside of health facilities (06.1). This includes maintenance and repair services for these items (06.1.4).
*   **Outpatient Care Services:** Preventive, dental, curative, and rehabilitative services provided by health-care professionals that do not require an overnight stay, including home-based medical care and long-term outpatient support (06.2).
*   **Inpatient Care Services:** Medical, curative, and long-term care services provided during an overnight stay in a health-care facility, including all integrated laboratory tests, medical supplies, and necessary accommodation services (06.3).
*   **Other Health Services:** Diagnostic imaging and medical laboratory services (e.g., MRI, X-ray, blood testing) and patient emergency transportation and rescue services, when these are priced separately from other care services (06.4).

The division also covers health-care services performed purely for aesthetic beautification purposes, such as cosmetic surgery.

This does not include food items, including those marketed for their health benefits or organic properties (01.1); products for personal care, hygiene, or beauty (13.1); non-medical residential facilities or social protection services (13.3); or medical products and services provided to patients that are not priced separately from their respective inpatient or outpatient care service packages (06.2, 06.3).

This category encompasses medicinal and health-related products, including medical and assistive devices, intended for the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of illnesses, diseases, and injuries. These items are typically purchased by individuals or households for use outside of a health facility or institution, often sourced from pharmacies, specialized suppliers, or reliable internet sources.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Medicines and Pharmaceutical Preparations:** All medicinal products used for health care, including branded and generic pharmaceuticals, vaccines, hormones, and oral contraceptives (0611). It also covers traditional medicines, such as herbal and homeopathic products (0611), as well as nutritional supplements like vitamins and minerals, dialysis fluids, and medical gases (0611). Pharmacist dispensing fees are also included here (0611).
*   **Medical Diagnostic and Preventive Products:** Non-durable items for self-testing and personal health monitoring, such as thermometers, blood glucose meters, and pregnancy testing kits (0612). It also includes protective and preventive goods like condoms and other mechanical contraceptives, medical masks, compression stockings, first-aid supplies, syringes, and inhalers (0612).
*   **Assistive Products:** Specialized devices designed to compensate for impairments or facilitate daily living. This includes visual aids (corrective eyeglasses, contact lenses, ocular prostheses), hearing and communication aids (digital hearing aids), and mobility/daily living aids (wheelchairs, walking frames, artificial limbs, therapeutic footwear, orthoses, and incontinence products) (0613).
*   **Maintenance and Technical Support:** Services related to the upkeep of medical and assistive goods, including the repair, maintenance, cleaning, and rental of diagnostic and assistive products for personal use (e.g., medical alarm systems) (0614).

This does not include: medicines and health products supplied directly by health-care providers in facilities to outpatients or inpatients if they are not priced separately from the care service (06.2, 06.3); dispensing fees not separately identifiable from the cost of the health-care service (06.2, 06.3); veterinary products (09.3.2.2); and products for personal care or beauty, such as aromatherapy products and slimming creams (13.1). Additionally, specific items such as dental implants and dentures (06.2, 06.3), recreational walking sticks (09.2.2.1), and non-corrective eyewear or earplugs (13.2.9.1) are excluded.

Group 06.2 encompasses a comprehensive range of preventive, dental, curative, rehabilitative, and long-term care services provided to patients on an outpatient basis, specifically those not involving an overnight stay. These services may be delivered across various settings, including hospital facilities, specialized consulting offices, or in the patient's home, by a wide spectrum of health-care professionals.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Preventive Care Services (06.2.1):** Professional medical activities focused on disease prevention and early detection, such as immunization and vaccination programs (e.g., against polio, influenza, or HPV), routine health monitoring, prenatal and postnatal care, family planning, genetic counselling, and screening for communicable and non-communicable diseases.
*   **Outpatient Dental Services (06.2.2):** All oral health services provided by dentists, dental surgeons, orthodontists, periodontists, and dental auxiliaries (such as oral hygienists). This includes routine preventive check-ups, restorative treatments, aesthetic dentistry, and surgical procedures (e.g., maxillofacial or oral surgery) performed without overnight hospitalization.
*   **Curative and Rehabilitative Services (06.2.3.1):** Diagnostic and therapeutic medical procedures, surgical interventions, obstetric services, and specialized therapies (e.g., physical, psychological, speech, or respiratory therapy) delivered in consulting facilities or as medical day-care.
*   **Long-Term and Home-Based Care (06.2.3.2):** Medical and nursing care designed to maintain health status or manage chronic conditions in elderly or disabled persons. This includes home-based medical treatments such as dialysis, palliative care, and nasogastric feeding, as well as integrated services provided by medical day-care centers.
*   **Integrated Supplies:** Health-related products—including medicines, assistive devices, and therapeutic items—as well as diagnostic imaging and laboratory services, provided they are included as part of an outpatient treatment package and are not priced separately from the professional service.

This does not include: dental, curative, rehabilitative, and long-term care services provided during an overnight stay (06.3); control and follow-up services for symptoms arising during overnight care (06.3); diagnostic imaging and medical laboratory services priced separately from the provided outpatient service (06.4.1.0); vaccines when priced separately from the administrative service (06.1.1.1); patient emergency transportation and rescue services (06.4.2.0); or non-medical home maintenance services not integrated into a medical care package (13.3.0.3).

This category encompasses professional medical services specifically designed to prevent the onset of illness and to detect diseases in their early stages, typically before any symptoms appear. It covers a broad spectrum of clinical activities ranging from mass immunization programs to routine health monitoring and disease screening.

This includes, among others:

*   **Immunization and Vaccination Services (06211):** This cluster covers the administration of vaccines and professional consultations, including routine immunizations for children and maternal care, travel-related vaccinations, and both compulsory and voluntary immunizations against conditions such as polio, influenza, hepatitis, HPV, and various other communicable diseases.
*   **Routine Health Monitoring and Screening (06219):** This cluster includes services focused on early detection and preventative health management, such as family planning and genetic counselling, prenatal and postnatal care, and general routine check-ups related to child growth and development. *   **Integrated Ancillary Services (06211, 06219):** This includes diagnostic imaging and medical laboratory services (such as mammograms or blood tests) when these are provided as part of the preventive service and priced jointly with the time and skills of the medical personnel.

detailled_description: The aim of outpatient long-term care services is not to cure an illness or rehabilitate an individual, but rather to prevent deterioration of the individual’s health condition and to thereby maintain it at a level available. Specific medical and nursing services are inherent contributors to this type of status quo. Individuals who may receive outpatient long-term care include elderly persons whose capacity to perform daily activities is limited, physically disabled household members and persons with chronic conditions.  Sometimes, outpatient long-term care services are part of a package of services that include social assistance and social transfer. Wherever possible in such cases, only the medical component should be classified to division 06; the social protection component should be classified to division 13. In cases where it is not possible to clearly distinguish between the components, the choice of division should depend on which component in the package of services is predominant. The parent category for inpatient care services encompasses medical, curative, rehabilitative, and long-term care services that require at least one overnight stay in a healthcare facility. The primary distinction between this category and outpatient care (06.2) is the requirement for overnight accommodation, regardless of the type of provider or the specific medical setting.

This category includes the following service clusters:

*   **Inpatient Curative and Rehabilitative Care:** Comprehensive treatment and care aimed at alleviating symptoms, reducing illness severity, preventing complications, or restoring physical and mental function (0631). This includes services provided by hospitals, nursing care facilities, alcohol and drug rehabilitation centers, and mental health convalescent homes, as well as any medical services, diagnostic imaging, laboratory tests, medicines, and assistive health products integrated into the stay (0631).
*   **Inpatient Long-term Care:** Services focused on preventing the deterioration of health conditions and maintaining the functional status of individuals with chronic conditions or disabilities (0632). This includes services provided by medical convalescent homes, skilled nursing facilities, teaching nursing homes, residential mental health and substance abuse facilities for chronic patients, palliative care facilities, and medical retirement homes or residences for persons with disabilities (0632).
*   **Ancillary and Supportive Services:** Essential accommodation services provided during an overnight stay, including meal services, facility cleaning, and the indispensable hosting of a patient’s relatives, regardless of whether these are priced separately (0631, 0632). This also includes elective procedures performed within a hospital setting, such as cosmetic surgeries that are not reconstructive in nature (0631).

Division 07 encompasses all goods and services associated with the personal mobility of individuals and the transportation of household goods. This includes the acquisition of transport equipment, the operational costs of maintaining such equipment, the provision of passenger transport services across various travel modes, and professional logistical services for the delivery and relocation of goods.

This division includes, among others:

*   **Purchase of Vehicles:** The acquisition of new and second-hand motor cars, motorcycles, bicycles (including electric variants), and animal-drawn vehicles (071).
*   **Operation of Personal Transport Equipment:** Expenditures for the maintenance and repair of vehicles, including the purchase of spare parts, accessories, fuels (petrol, diesel, electricity, etc.), and lubricants. It also covers ancillary costs such as parking fees, tolls, driving licenses, and vehicle-sharing or rental services (072).
*   **Passenger Transport Services:** The provision of transport for individuals via rail, road, air, and inland waterways. This cluster covers scheduled and chartered services, such as trains, buses, taxis, ride-sharing, flights, and maritime travel, as well as combined multi-modal transport and specialized services like cable cars and funiculars (073).
*   **Transport Services for Goods:** Logistics services comprising postal and courier activities, professional household removal and storage services, and separately priced delivery services for goods such as groceries or furniture (074).

This division does not include ambulance services (06.4.2.0); purchases of recreational vehicles, such as camper vans, caravans, trailers, aeroplanes, or boats (09.1.2); rental of transport equipment for purely recreational purposes (09.4.2.2); cable car and chairlift services specifically operated at ski resorts (09.4.6.2); package holidays (09.8.0.0); or the rental of parking spaces connected to a private dwelling (04.1.2.2).

This category includes, among others:

*   **Motorcycles:** All types of motorized two-wheeled transport, including motorcycles (combustion or electric), motor scooters, mopeds, motorized bicycles with combustion engines, sidecars, and snowmobiles (0712).
*   **Bicycles:** All human-powered or electrically assisted cycles, including traditional bicycles, tricycles, cycle rickshaws, electric bicycles (e-bikes), pedelecs, and electric kick scooters (0713).

This category encompasses all expenditures related to the maintenance, repair, and operational requirements of personal transport equipment, as well as ancillary services associated with the ownership and usage of these vehicles. It covers the acquisition of necessary physical components, fuels, and professional services required to keep personal transport equipment in functioning order.

This category includes the following clusters:

*   **Parts and Accessories:** This includes the purchase of spare parts and replacement components (e.g., tyres, tubes, batteries, spark plugs, filters, and rims). It also covers safety and functional accessories such as child seats, crash helmets, fire extinguishers, roof racks, cargo boxes, dash cameras, and electric vehicle chargers (0721).
*   **Fuels and Maintenance Fluids:** This includes petrol, diesel, and alternative energy sources (e.g., LPG, CNG/LNG, biofuels, hydrogen, and electricity when separately metered). It also encompasses chemical maintenance products such as lubricants, brake and transmission fluids, coolants, and vehicle additives (0722).
*   **Maintenance and Repair Services:** This includes professional services purchased by households for the upkeep of vehicles, such as the fitting of parts, oil changes, greasing, washing, polishing, wheel balancing, tyre changing, breakdown assistance, and locksmith services for vehicles (0723).
*   **Other Transport Services:** This includes parking fees (meters, garages, and residential permits), toll charges (bridges, tunnels, and motorways), and regulatory fees related to driving and vehicle ownership (driving lessons, licences, roadworthiness tests, and emissions checks). It also includes the short-term rental of vehicles and participation fees for sharing schemes (0724).

This does not include non-specific cleaning or maintenance products like household sponges or detergents (05.6.1.1), audio and video systems installed in cars (08.1.4.0), or insurance service charges (12.1.4.1). Furthermore, it excludes the rental of parking spaces connected to a private dwelling (04.1.2.2), passenger transport services with a driver (07.3.2.2), and the rental of transport equipment for purely recreational purposes (09.4.2.2).

It also covers technical support and repair tasks, including the fitting of parts and accessories, tyre changing, and wheel balancing (07230). Furthermore, the category comprises specialized automotive services, specifically breakdown services, the installation of car cameras, and locksmith services for vehicles (07230).

This does not include parts, accessories, or lubricants purchased separately by households for self-maintenance or repair purposes (07.2.1, 07.2.2.4), nor does it include mandatory roadworthiness tests (07.2.4.3).

This category covers a range of ancillary services associated with the ownership and operation of personal transport equipment, excluding direct passenger transport services. It encompasses essential infrastructure fees, regulatory and administrative requirements for drivers and vehicles, as well as short-term rental arrangements.

The scope of this category includes the following areas:

*   **Parking Services:** This includes the rental of municipal street parking, the use of parking meters (attendant or automated), and the rental of parking spaces in garages or shopping centres (including valet services and residential parking permits) (07.2.4.1). 
*   **Toll Facilities:** This includes bridge, tunnel, and motorway tolls, as well as the costs associated with the rental or purchase of electronic tags and toll collection devices (07.2.4.2).
*   **Driving and Vehicle Certification:** This includes driving lessons, driving tests, the issuance of driving licences, roadworthiness and emissions control tests, and vehicle registration fees. It also covers charges related to the transfer of vehicle ownership and training/licensing associated with recreational transport vehicles (07.2.4.3).
*   **Rental of Personal Transport Equipment:** This includes the short-term hire of personal vehicles without a driver, as well as participation fees for car-, bicycle-, and motorcycle-sharing schemes (07.2.4.4).

This category does not include the rental of parking spaces or garages that are tied to a private dwelling (04.1.2.2), passenger transport services provided by taxis or hired vehicles with drivers, or private ride-sharing/carpooling arrangements (07.3.2.2). Additionally, it excludes the rental of transport equipment for purely recreational purposes (09.4.2.2) and service charges for vehicle insurance (12.1.4.1).

This category encompasses the provision of passenger transport services across all modes of travel, including rail, road, air, sea, and inland waterways. It covers the transport of persons and their accompanied luggage, as well as the transport of private vehicles where applicable, and includes various auxiliary services related to passenger mobility.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Rail and Road Transport:** Rail-based systems, including long-distance intercity trains, high-speed rail, magnetic levitation (maglev) trains, and urban transit systems such as undergrounds, tramways, and light rail (0731). Road-based transport includes buses, coaches, trolleybuses, share taxis, private arrangements like carpooling and ride-sharing, school transport services, and specialized transport such as taxis, rickshaws, tuk-tuks, and animal-drawn vehicles (0732).
*   **Air and Water Transport:** Scheduled and chartered air transport for passengers via aeroplane, helicopter, drone, and multi-copter (0733), as well as maritime and inland waterway transport via ships, boats, ferries, hovercraft, hydrofoils, and water taxis (0734).
*   **Combined and Auxiliary Services:** Combined passenger transport services for multi-modal trips where expenditure cannot be apportioned between modes (0735). Other services include specialized conveyances such as funiculars, elevators, transporter bridges, and cable cars, alongside passenger support services such as porters, luggage forwarding, left-luggage storage, and separately invoiced travel agents’ commissions (0736).

Where fares include meals, snacks, drinks, or accommodation services that are not priced separately, these costs are included in this group; if priced separately, they are classified under division 11.

This does not include ambulance services (06.4.2.0), package holidays (09.8.0.0), or cable car and chairlift transport services specifically operated at ski resorts and holiday centres (09.4.6.2).

This category encompasses the transportation of passengers and their accompanied luggage via various rail-based systems, ranging from long-distance national and international train networks to urban rapid transit and tramways. It also covers the transport of accompanied private vehicles via rail services.

The scope of this category is structured as follows:

*   **Intercity and Long-Distance Rail:** This includes the transport of persons, accompanied luggage, and private vehicles via standard trains, high-speed rail services, and magnetic levitation (maglev) trains (07311).
*   **Urban and Suburban Rail Systems:** This includes the transport of persons and accompanied luggage via rapid transit systems—such as electric railways operating on exclusive rights of way, grade-separated tunnels, or elevated tracks—as well as light rail, underground systems, rubber-tyred metros, people movers, and tramway services (07312).

This category does not include funicular transport, which is classified separately under 07.3.6.0.

This category encompasses the provision of passenger transport services by road, utilizing a diverse range of vehicles and operational models to facilitate personal mobility and the carriage of accompanied luggage. It covers services ranging from scheduled transit and contract-based transport to flexible, on-demand, and private arrangements.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Public and Shared Road Transport:** The transport of persons and accompanied luggage via bus, trolleybus, and coach, as well as share taxis, which operate as vehicles for hire—typically ranging from four-seat cars to minibuses—that function along fixed or semi-fixed routes without formal timetables (07321).
*   **Taxis and Private Arrangements:** The transport of passengers and accompanied luggage provided by taxis and hired vehicles with drivers, along with services based on private arrangements, including carpooling and ride-sharing platforms (07322).
*   **School Transport Services:** The transport of pupils between their homes and schools or between different school locations, encompassing local school bus charter services as well as inter-urban and intercity school bus services operating on fixed schedules (07323).
*   **Other Road-Based Passenger Services:** The transport of persons and accompanied luggage via animal-drawn vehicles with a driver, as well as specialized small-scale transport services including tuk-tuks, auto and cycle rickshaws, and motorcycles serving as taxis (07329).

This category does not include the transport of persons and accompanied luggage by buses with a driver, which is explicitly classified under category 07321.

Division 08 encompasses the equipment, software, and services essential for information processing, telecommunications, and the reception, recording, and reproduction of sound and vision. It covers the full lifecycle of these technologies, including hardware acquisition, software licensing, and the ongoing provision of connectivity and digital media services.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Information and Communication Equipment:** A comprehensive range of consumer hardware, including telecommunication devices like fixed-line and mobile phones (0811, 0812), information processing hardware such as computers, printers, and peripheral devices (0813), and audio-visual equipment including television sets, radio receivers, and high-fidelity sound systems (0814). It also covers storage media (0815) and various consumer electronics and accessories, such as smartwatches, e-book readers, cables, and internal computer components (0819).
*   **Software:** All computer software products designed for utility, professional, or personal productivity, including operating systems, specialized applications, and cloud-based software subscriptions (0820).
*   **Information and Communication Services:** The provision of telecommunication networks, including fixed-line and mobile telephone services (0831, 0832), internet access services (0833), and bundled telecommunication packages (0834). This cluster also includes media and broadcasting services, such as public television and radio license fees, subscription-based streaming services for music and film, and cable or satellite television access (0839). Furthermore, it includes the professional repair, maintenance, and rental of all information and communication hardware (0835, 0839).

This category does not include video game software or consoles (0921), digital educational or reference materials (0971), recorded media (0952, 0971), or audiovisual content purchased online for immediate downloading (0952). Additionally, it excludes mobile telephone equipment when sold separately from a subscription plan.

This parent category encompasses a comprehensive range of equipment designed for information processing, telecommunications, and the reception, recording, and reproduction of sound and vision. It includes primary consumer hardware, peripheral devices, storage media, and the various accessories necessary for their operation.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Telecommunication Equipment:** Fixed-line telephones, telefax machines, telephone answering machines, and telephone loudspeakers (0811), as well as mobile devices such as smartphones and multifunctional mobile handsets (0812).
*   **Information Processing Equipment:** Computers (desktop, laptop, and tablet), peripheral devices (printers, including 3-D printers, photocopiers, scanners, monitors, projectors, and networking hardware such as routers and modems), and input devices (keyboards, mice, and digitizers). This cluster also includes office tools like electronic calculators, typewriters, and word processors, along with essential consumables such as toner, ink cartridges, and printer drums (0813).
*   **Audio-Visual Equipment:** Devices for the reception, recording, and reproduction of sound and vision, including television sets, video recorders, DVD/Blu-ray players, streaming boxes, radio receivers, stereo equipment, amplifiers, microphones, speakers, and personal listening devices such as headphones and headsets (0814).
*   **Recording Media:** All forms of blank or unrecorded physical storage media, ranging from optical discs (CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray) and magnetic tapes to solid-state storage (USB flash drives, memory cards) and external or network-attached hardware (hard drives and SSDs) (0815).
*   **Specialized Accessories and Consumer Electronics:** Various portable electronic devices such as baby monitors, e-book readers, and wearable technology (e.g., smartwatches, fitness trackers, smartglasses). This also covers essential operational accessories like chargers, power banks, cables, docking stations, protective cases, and internal computer hardware components such as processors, motherboards, and memory modules (0819).

This does not include telefax and telephone-answering facilities provided by personal computers (08131); computer software packages (0820); video game software, computers, or consoles (09211); digital educational content in the form of software (09711); or recorded recording media (09520, 0971).

Division 09 encompasses a wide range of goods and services related to recreation, sport, and culture, structured to capture the diverse ways households engage in leisure and personal development. This division includes both durable and non-durable recreational goods, cultural media, horticultural and pet-related products, and a broad spectrum of services ranging from arts and entertainment to organized travel and sports participation.

This category includes, among others:

*   **Recreational and Sporting Durables:** Major durable equipment, including photographic and optical instruments (e.g., cameras, binoculars, telescopes), recreational vehicles (e.g., camper vans, caravans), watercraft (e.g., boats, yachts), and sporting apparatus (09.1).
*   **Other Recreational and Hobby Goods:** A diverse array of leisure articles, including games, toys, video game hardware and software, sporting and gymnastic equipment, and camping and outdoor gear (09.2).
*   **Garden and Pet Products:** Horticultural items including plants, flowers, seeds, and fertilizers, as well as pets and the various goods required for their maintenance, such as feed and specialized equipment (09.3).
*   **Recreational and Cultural Services:** Services related to the rental, maintenance, and repair of recreational goods; professional veterinary and animal-related services; participation in sports, fitness, and amusement activities; games of chance; and services provided by cultural institutions such as cinemas, theatres, museums, and libraries (09.4, 09.6).
*   **Cultural Goods:** Musical instruments and various forms of audiovisual media, including both physical discs and digital downloads of music and films (09.5).
*   **Reading and Stationery Materials:** Books, newspapers, and periodicals in both printed and electronic formats, alongside a comprehensive range of writing, drawing, and office stationery (09.7).
*   **Package Holidays:** All-inclusive travel arrangements that bundle services such as transportation, accommodation, catering, and excursions, for which individual expenditure breakdown is not feasible (09.8).

This does not include gardening services (classified under housing/maintenance), motorized gardening equipment, certain protective gear like crash helmets (classified under transport), professional formal education (classified under education), or services related to the rental of transport equipment. Additionally, it excludes horses and equipment purchased specifically for personal transport, pet services such as veterinary care (which are excluded from the pet products group, though captured under recreational services), and any individual components of a travel package if purchased separately.

*   **Games, Toys, and Hobby Articles:** This cluster includes video gaming hardware (consoles, computers, and peripherals) and software (physical and digital media) (09.2.1.1). It also covers traditional playthings such as board games, card games, dolls, soft toys, construction sets, and puzzles, alongside hobby-specific requisites like collections (stamps, coins, minerals, and specimens) and festive celebration items such as holiday decorations and fireworks (09.2.1.2, 09.2.1.3).
*   **Sporting and Gymnastic Equipment:** This includes athletic gear for physical training and competition, such as balls, rackets, bats, golf clubs, skis, weights, and bodybuilding equipment (09.2.2.1). It further encompasses equipment for hunting and outdoor sports, including firearms, ammunition, fishing rods, parachutes, and recreational skateboards or hoverboards (09.2.2.1).
*   **Camping and Outdoor Recreational Gear:** This covers equipment designed for open-air environments, including tents, sleeping bags, backpacks, air mattresses, and camping stoves (09.2.2.2). It also includes beach and leisure items like inflatable boats, rafts, portable swimming pools, and recreational walking sticks (09.2.2.2).
*   **Specialized Apparel and Accessories:** The category includes game-specific footwear (such as ski boots or cleats), protective sports gear (helmets for sports, life jackets, padding, and goggles), and navigation tools like handheld GPS devices for hiking and boating (09.2.2.1, 09.2.2.2).

This category encompasses equipment, accessories, and specialized apparel used for physical exercise, sporting activities, hunting, camping, and outdoor recreation. It covers both the technical gear required for participation in these activities and the specialized items necessary for safety, navigation, and comfort in an outdoor environment.

This includes, among others:

*   **Sporting and Gymnastic Equipment:** A wide range of athletic gear, including balls, shuttlecocks, nets, rackets, bats, skis, golf clubs, foils, sabres, poles, javelins, weights, and bodybuilding equipment such as dumbbells and chest expanders (09221). This also includes firearms, ammunition, other weapons, and body armour used for hunting, sport, and personal protection, as well as skateboards, kickboards, hoverboards, and recreational walking sticks (09221).
*   **Specialized Sports Apparel and Protective Gear:** Game-specific footwear (e.g., ski boots, football boots, and shoes fitted with ice skates, rollers, or studs), specialized sportswear (e.g., ski suits), and comprehensive protective gear such as helmets, life jackets, boxing gloves, body padding, shin guards, and goggles (09221).

It also covers essential camping gear, such as tents, sleeping bags, backpacks, air mattresses, camping stoves with fuel, barbecues, and other camping accessories (09222).
*   **Navigation and Maintenance:** Global Positioning System (GPS) equipment specifically designed for boating and hiking, as well as materials purchased by households for the self-repair and maintenance of such equipment.

This does not include garden and camping furniture (05.1.1.2), crash helmets for motorcycles or bicycles (07.2.1.3), or the rental and repair services for sporting, camping, and open-air recreation equipment (09.4.4.0).

Furthermore, it encompasses all botanical items, including indoor and outdoor plants, shrubs, seeds, bulbs, tubers, natural or artificial flowers, wreaths for burial places, and cut flowers (09.3.1).

This parent category encompasses a wide array of services related to recreation, leisure, and sporting activities, as well as the rental, maintenance, and repair of various recreational equipment. It covers both active participation in sports and entertainment, the specialized care of household pets, and expenditures related to games of chance.

This includes, among others:

*   **Rental, Repair, and Maintenance of Recreational Equipment:** Services for photographic and cinematographic equipment and optical instruments (0941); major recreational durables, including camper vans, caravans, boats, and aircraft (0942); games, toys, and hobby-related articles, including digital gaming software and platforms (0943); and sporting, camping, and open-air equipment, such as beach furniture (0944).

This also includes spectator fees for live sporting events (0946), as well as general leisure services provided at amusement parks, fairgrounds, gaming arcades, and dancing establishments (0946).

*   **Games of Chance:** Service charges and expenditures for participation in lotteries, casinos, betting, bingo, scratch cards, and online gambling platforms (0947).

This does not include:

*   Rental of equipment for transport (07244).
*   Pet products such as food and accessories (09322).
